Source: Faith and Fire, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

Technically a disease of the nervous system rather than a derangement, the effects of Saint Vitus's Dance are considered a form of madness by the inhabitants of the Dark Medieval. It causes involuntary spasms of the face and limbs, resulting in dancelike movements that persist for days or weeks before disappearing - sometimes permanently, but often recurring after months or years. Unlike most mortal diseases, Cainites can suffer from it, contracted via infected blood.

Trigger/Effect: Depending on the level of stress, the sufferer is considered one to three Traits down in any challenges (exact penalty and which Traits it applies to are left to the Narrator).
